top.author: @DiogenesWorld
top.text: It’s bc we’re so heavily unionized. Unions are the death of efficiency & productivity Unions are anti-meritocracy & anti-automation by design. They push fast workers to slow down, lest the rest look bad. And why let one machine do what 100 paid workers could do? Kill the unions
top.translationZh: 这是因为我们工会化程度太高了。工会就是效率和生产力的杀手。工会在设计上就是反精英制度、反自动化的。他们逼着干活快的人放慢速度，免得让其他人显得太菜。而且一台机器能干的活，为什么不让100个拿工资的工人来做呢？干掉工会吧

top.author: @productnatives
top.text: Zuckerberg building a personal AI agent isn't a productivity story. It's an admission that nobody has built the right software for the person at the top. The CEO layer is the last unseated enterprise category. That's the product bet worth watching.
top.translationZh: 扎克伯格搞个人AI助手这事儿，根本不是什么提升效率的故事。这是在承认没人为顶层大佬做出过合适的软件。CEO这个层面是企业软件最后一个没被攻下的市场。这才是值得关注的产品押注。

top.author: @BoluwatifeOmil1
top.text: At the end of it all, it’s all survival. Not the movie kind. The quiet Lagos grind wake up, heart still beating through the heat, the traffic, the bills, the noise. Eat what you can. Laugh when you can. Protect your peace and your people. Love carefully. Keep the spark lit.
top.translationZh: 到头来，这一切都是关于生存。不是电影里那种生存，是那种安静的拉各斯式挣扎——醒来时心脏还在跳动，熬过酷热、拥堵、账单和噪音。能吃就吃，能笑就笑。守护好内心的平静和身边的人。小心翼翼地去爱。让心中那团火一直燃着。
